While dogfooding pm-changelog in unbraind/pm-cli, the main CHANGELOG.md can be regenerated in a misleading state while checks still pass.

Observed in pm-cli on 2026-05-24:
- latest installed pm-changelog: 2026.5.24-9
- package doctor is clean and contracts expose changelog generate plus --item-url-base
- package.json check script runs: pm changelog generate --output CHANGELOG.md --group-by release --status closed --item-url-base ... --check
- because no --release-version or release-range derivation is supplied, most closed items without release metadata fall into ## Unreleased, while the actual released package version is 2026.5.24
- the check passes because it compares against the same bad generation

Expected:
pm-changelog should provide a package-owned/default release mode suitable for CI/CD that derives the release heading and previous-tag range from package/git state, or otherwise fails when a generated release changelog would assign all historical closed items to Unreleased. This should let consumers avoid custom wrapper scripts and still produce a Keep-a-Changelog-style useful CHANGELOG.md with clickable pm item links.

pm-cli should then consume that package functionality instead of hand-writing or custom-generating changelog content.

---
